solutions.title: Build a new unique list
solutions.strategy: Collect the first value of each sorted run, then build a fresh linked list from those values.

timeComplexity.explanation: The list is traversed once and a new node is built for each unique value.

spaceComplexity.explanation: `u` unique values are stored and rebuilt.

solutions.title: In-place run skipping
solutions.strategy: Walk the list and bypass the next node whenever it has the same value as the current node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is inspected at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm rewires existing `next` pointers without auxiliary collections.
